annotations.text:
BenchMate phone screens, 390×844. Static mockups.
Direction: 1970s bench instrument. Deep teal ground, cream text, orange for the thing you act on or the number you were looking for, teal for structure.
Type: DM Serif Display (wordmark, step titles) · Atkinson Hyperlegible (UI) · JetBrains Mono (every number).
Alternate ground: cream paper instead of deep teal. Same components, same accents. Pick one, or keep both as light/dark.
Bands drawn from core/data/ladders/generuler-1kb-plus.json on a log scale. Reference bands (5000, 1500, 500) are heavier and show ng in orange.
Step 5 of the Lipofectamine 3000 sheet. The per-well lines from the Word doc become a master-mix table: wells × amount + 10 %.
